metadata.description: Captured GET /api/mdm/updates/{updateUuid}/groups/{organizationGroupUuid}/device-status — real 404 error response. Hand-authored from a raw curl capture (not via bin/mock-capture, which log.Fatal-exits on non-2xx status before writing a fixture) because the test org group has zero device-update deployments across all updates in scope, so this endpoint cannot return a 200 in this environment; the 404 status and errorCode 5223 message shape are genuine, unmutated live-server content for every update UUID tried, not a fabricated shape -- DISCLOSURE: the update_uuid embedded in the message text (aaaaaaaa_bbbb_cccc_dddd_eeeeeeeeeeee) and activityId (99999999_8888_7777_6666_555544443333) are hand-typed sequential-hex placeholders substituted into the real curl capture, not genuine server-issued values.
